archetype: The Performance Pro / High Contrast Logistics

typography.rules: Avoid Inter. Do not use 'bold' arbitrarily. Data/Numbers MUST use JetBrains Mono for strict alignment.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Use gap-6 for macro layout.
layouts.borders_and_radius: Soft borders (border-white/10). Rounded corners (rounded-xl for cards, rounded-2xl for main containers, rounded-full for pills/buttons).

components.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar. bg-[#0A0A0A] border-r border-white/10. Active item uses text-[#FACC15] and a 2px left border of #FACC15.
components.top_bar: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 border-b border-white/10. Must not be fully transparent.
components.cards: bg-[#121212] border border-white/10 rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-white/20.
components.tables: Dense rows. text-sm. Headers are text-xs uppercase text-zinc-500. Use JetBrains Mono for ID, License Plate, and Costs.
components.badges: Pill shaped (rounded-full) px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium border.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#FACC15] text-black hover:bg-[#EAB308] font-semibold rounded-md. Secondary: bg-white/5 text-white hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10.
components.charts: Recharts inside cards. Use custom tooltips with dark bg-[#121212] and border-white/10. Colors: use primary accent and status colors.

visual_enhancers.noise: Add a subtle SVG noise filter or simple dark grain to the background for an industrial tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(250,204,21,0.15)] sparingly on active top-level metrics.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react with consistent stroke widths (strokeWidth={1.5}).

motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for dashboard cards using simple css animation.

accessibility.focus: Visible focus states using the yellow accent color.
accessibility.contrast: Text must have sufficient contrast. Muted text should not drop below #71717A.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.

image_urls.description: Large truck travels on a highway at dusk. Perfect for login/signup page full-bleed background with a dark overlay (bg-black/60).
Driver portrait reflected in side mirror. Use for driver profiles or dummy avatars.
Professional woman in dark setting. Use for Safety Officer / Fleet Manager profile avatar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the Google Fonts import into index.html.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and key metric cards.
Implement mock JSON data that covers all Roles (Fleet Manager, Driver, Safety Officer, Financial Analyst) and demonstrate RBAC in the sidebar.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the Kanban board structure to allow flexible dragging/states.
Use Recharts for Fuel Efficiency, Fleet Utilization, and Cost Trends charts. Strip out default light tooltips and replace with dark custom ones.
Use sonner for toast notifications (loading, success, error).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center align the app container. Create depth with z-index, subtle borders (border-white/10), and dark cards (bg-[#121212]). Add micro-animations on hover. Use generous padding (p-6/p-8). Do NOT use generic purple/blue SaaS gradients. Stick to the Industrial/Tactical color palette (#0A0A0A base, Yellow/Signal accents, JetBrains Mono for data).
